paper_title: Can We Edit LLMs for Long-Tail Biomedical Knowledge
caption: The performance of knowledge probing after editing with different editing methods on BioMedLM, where “Base” denotes LLM without editing.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the co-occurrence number and accuracy (ACC) percentage across six different lines. The x-axis, labeled "Co-occurrence Number", has a exponential scale, values ranging from 10^0 to 10^3, with tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis, labeled "ACC (%)", uses a linear scale with a value range from 40 to 65, and tick marks at intervals of 5. The black line with circular markers and a solid style, representing "Base," shows a steady increase from approximately 38% at 5 to around 44% bit beyond 10^3. The blue line with inverted triangular markers, labeled "FT," follows a solid style, starting around 40% at 5 and rising to about 47% bit beyond 10^3. "IKE", depicted by a red line with triangular markers and a solid style, increases consistently from about 43% at 5 to 49% bit beyond 10^3. The brown line with diamond markers, representing "MEND", features a solid style, beginning around 45% at 5 and attaining approximately 56% bit beyond 10^3. The purple line, representing "MEMIT", with pentagon markers and a solid style, climbs from roughly 43% at 5 to 55% bit beyond 10^3. Lastly, the green line with square markers, representing "ROME", follows a solid style, rising from about 51% at 5 to 66% bit beyond 10^3, showing the steepest increase among the lines. A legend is given in top left, describing the line and color.
